{07 06 00}But I'm all better now
thanks to the {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}
{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} brought me!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I was violently sick for
a while.{01 00 00 05 00} I never knew my
body could do...what it did.
{07 16 00}But because {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} 
{ff 00 00 00}took such good care of me,{01 00 00 05 00}
I was able to recover.
{07 07 00}It was pretty touch and go
there for a while{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 14 00}But, {01 00 00 05 00}then again, you had no
idea,{01 00 00 0f 00} did you?

{07 01 00}{01 08 00}DID YOU, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olin tükk aega
ränkhaige.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei teadnud, et
mu keha seda teha oskab.
{07 16 00}Aga kuna {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}
{ff 00 00 00}hoolitses minu eest nii,{01 00 00 05 00}
suutsin ma paraneda.
{07 07 00}Mõnda aega oli seis
päris kriitiline{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 14 00}Aga {01 00 00 05 00}sul polnud sellest

{07 01 00}{01 08 00}EGA JU, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Man, {01 00 00 05 00}that was the worst!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}So, I caught the flu in the
worst way.

You know, I write the names
of people who do nice
things for me on a list.
{07 19 00}Like{ff 00 00 05} {04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, for
example. {01 00 00 05 00}That kid's even
got a gold star{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 04 00}Oh, my!{01 00 00 0f 00} What's this?{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}Next to your name is a
skull and crossbones!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Poiss, {01 00 00 05 00}see oli kõige hullem!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Nii et ma sain gripi
kõige hullemal moel.

Tead, ma kirjutan nimekirja
nende nimed, kes minu heaks
midagi head teevad.
{07 19 00}Näiteks{ff 00 00 05} {04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}Sellel
lapsel on isegi
kuldtäht{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 04 00}Oh sa!{01 00 00 0f 00} Mis see on?{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}Sinu nime kõrval on
pealuu ja kondid!
